memory_recovered.durable_rule: For project continuity, canonical repository state and immutable commit evidence outrank run summaries. Negative search results prove absence only within the recorded coverage envelope.
memory_recovered.operational_effect: Future teams must preserve mismatches as unresolved claims, include query coverage, and avoid recreating missing artifacts under the same identifiers.

coverage_limit: Exact default-branch files and repository-indexed commit/code search were inspected, but exhaustive branch enumeration and private chat-history provenance were unavailable.
privacy_boundary: Only repository metadata, operational identifiers, and abstract process rules are included. No private chat text, health information, personal identifiers, or sensitive project content is reproduced.
falsification_route: This reconciliation is falsified if an immutable repository commit or branch is later produced containing authentic M-004, M-005, or M-006 artifacts that predate this evidence. In that case, link the commit, revise the unresolved claims, and preserve this audit as the earlier coverage-limited observation.
